caption: The drawing features a geometric and floral patterned design divided into sections, primarily using red, blue, and white colors. The left side of the image contains a large, octagonal frame in red with floral motifs inside, including stylized flowers, leaves, and a central star-shaped flower pattern. Blue and white floral designs fill the space around the central motif, with symmetrical arrangements of vines and blossoms. To the right, there are vertical bands with repeating geometric and floral patterns, alternating between blue and red backgrounds. Some bands feature diamond shapes and intertwining vines, while others display abstract forms and floral elements. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular border, and horizontal red and blue stripes overlay parts of the drawing, intersecting with the various decorative elements. The drawing is detailed and repetitive, using line work and filled areas to create intricate motifs throughout.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
